'''Scarab swarms''' are low levelled bug swarms that can poison, up to about 44 life points. They do not spawn on their own, and will only appear when a player fulfils certain conditions such as triggering a trap. They can also be summoned by a [[scabaras mage]] that is attacking a player. They will despawn shortly after leaving combat.

During [[Contact!]], three swarms appear from the ground and unite to become a [[giant scarab]]. After it has been defeated, they split again and disappear.
